# KBopped

> > A K-pop and J-pop music review blog featuring song and album critiques, year-end rankings, and personal listening charts.

KBopped is run by Arpydarpy and covers Korean and Japanese pop music with detailed reviews of releases from groups like RIIZE, Aespa, BTS, ONEUS, Monsta X, and producers like Sweetune. The site features comprehensive year-end Top 100 countdowns, monthly roundups, and a Hall of Fame series celebrating classic K-pop tracks.

## Key Topics

- K-pop song reviews
- Boy groups (BTS, RIIZE, ONEUS, Monsta X, Cravity, Verivery, Enhypen, NCT 127, TXT, Winner)
- Girl groups (Aespa, IVE, fromis_9, KARA, April)
- HYBE and SM Entertainment artists
- Sweetune production
- Year-end Top 100 rankings
- Album reviews
- Debut and comeback reviews
- Anime openings and J-pop
- Personal music charts and statistics
- K-pop Hall of Fame
- Monthly K-pop roundups

## Song Reviews

- [Song Review: IVE – Rebel Heart](https://kbopped.com/2025/01/13/song-review-ive-rebel-heart): Review of IVE's rock-influenced 2025 single Rebel Heart
- [Song Review: RIIZE – Get a Guitar](https://kbopped.com/2023/09/05/song-review-riize-get-a-guitar): Review of SM Entertainment's new boy group RIIZE debut single Get a Guitar
- [Song Review: Enhypen – Bad Desire (With Or Without You)](https://kbopped.com/2025/07/29/song-review-enhypen-bad-desire-with-or-without-you): Review of HYBE group Enhypen's R&B track Bad Desire
- [SONG REVIEW: Winner – I Love U](https://kbopped.com/2022/07/06/song-review-winner-i-love-u): Review of Winner's comeback single I Love U after 2-year military hiatus
- [SONG REVIEW: RoaD-B – Icarus](https://kbopped.com/2022/09/22/song-review-road-b-icarus): Review of RoaD-B's Sweetune-produced sophomore single Icarus
- [SONG REVIEW: Break All The Rules – Cravity](https://kbopped.com/2020/04/15/song-review-break-all-the-rules-cravity): Review of Starship Entertainment's Cravity debut single Break All The Rules
- [SONG REVIEW: 2U – Kang Daniel](https://kbopped.com/2020/03/25/song-review-2u-kang-daniel): Review of former Wanna One member Kang Daniel's solo single 2U
- [SONG REVIEW: Now Or Never – April](https://kbopped.com/2020/07/31/song-review-now-or-never-april): Review of April's summer comeback Now Or Never after Lalalilala success
- [SONG REVIEW: Feel Good (Secret Code) – fromis_9](https://kbopped.com/2020/09/16/song-review-feel-good-secret-code-fromis_9): Review of fromis_9's retro comeback Feel Good after 15-month hiatus
- [SONG REVIEW: G.B.T.B – Verivery](https://kbopped.com/2020/10/18/song-review-g-b-t-b-verivery): Critical review of Verivery's G.B.T.B single with negative assessment
- [Thoughts on NCT 127's Sticker](https://kbopped.com/2021/10/05/thoughts-on-nct-127s-sticker): Critical commentary on NCT 127's polarizing single Sticker

## Year-End Rankings & Top Lists

- [The Top 100 K-Pop Songs of 2021 (Honourable Mentions)](https://kbopped.com/2022/01/03/the-top-100-k-pop-songs-of-2021-honourable-mentions): Year-end 2021 countdown featuring honorable mentions including Aespa
- [The Top 100 K-Pop Songs of 2020 (20 – 11)](https://kbopped.com/2020/12/24/the-top-100-k-pop-songs-of-2020-20-11): Year-end countdown ranking top K-pop songs of 2020, positions 20-11
- [K-POP Monthly Roundup: August 2020](https://kbopped.com/2020/09/14/k-pop-monthly-roundup-august-2020): Monthly ranking of top 5 singles, B-sides, and albums from August 2020

## Album Reviews & Features

- [Album Review: TXT – minisode 2: Thursday's Child](https://kbopped.com/2022/05/19/album-review-txt-minisode-2-thursdays-child): Full album review of TXT's minisode 2: Thursday's Child concept album
- [KPOP HALL OF FAME: STEP – KARA](https://kbopped.com/2020/03/29/kpop-hall-of-fame-step-kara): Hall of Fame tribute to KARA's Step, honoring late member Goo Hara

## Optional

- [The 100 Best Anime Openings Of All Time (30-21)](https://kbopped.com/2021/02/22/the-100-best-anime-openings-of-all-time-30-21): Anime opening rankings featuring Naruto Shippuden's Blue Bird and more
- [SONG REVIEW: Unreal Trip – Eir Aoi](https://kbopped.com/2020/08/15/song-review-unreal-trip-eir-aoi): Review of Sword Art Online singer Eir Aoi's EDM track Unreal Trip
- [Kbopped's Weekly Stats (vol. 1)](https://kbopped.com/2022/05/02/kboppeds-weekly-stats-vol-1): Weekly music listening stats from Last.fm featuring personal charts
- [KBOPPED Weekly Charts: 17/06/20](https://kbopped.com/2020/06/17/kbopped-weekly-charts-17-06-20): Personal weekly K-pop charts based on play history and listening data
